review_scope: Initial static review of all four mob classes, Gelid snowball goal/handler, projectile/arrow and Zombie freeze mixins, entity registration and mixin plugin. Whole-mod semantic exclusion ledger and vanilla/downstream review are unfinished.
compat_note: No pack-wide absence claim is made. The four separately pinned compat candidates and other installed injection/data surfaces still require relevance review.

findings.display_name: Thicket melee / Verdant arrow Poison payload
findings.actual_behavior: Thicket calls super.doHurtTarget first, then on success with empty main hand and a LivingEntity target applies vanilla POISON through LivingEntity.addEffect with itself as source. Verdant calls super.getArrow and adds a POISON MobEffectInstance only when the returned projectile is an Arrow. These are separate application paths.
alternate_sources: variantsandventures:verdant using its native bow attack; distinct mandatory projectile representative
pending: Trace actual Minecraft 1.21.1 Arrow payload-to-target duration and poison ticking/immunities/merge behavior before final comparison.

findings.actual_behavior: Melee: successful super.doHurtTarget, empty main hand, LivingEntity and canFreeze gates precede setTicksFrozen(240). Snowball: ProjectileHitEvent listener checks Snowball owned by Gelid and a LivingEntity hit, requests 4 damage through the owner's vanilla thrown-source factory, then sets frozen ticks to 240 without checking canFreeze or the hurt return value. Assignment replaces the timer; it does not add 240. This is not a registered freezing MobEffect.
findings.primary_test_source: variantsandventures:gelid with empty main hand for melee
alternate_sources: Native Gelid ranged goal consumes one offhand minecraft:snowball and launches a genuinely owned Snowball; distinct required path
pending: Trace Snowball.onHitEntity -> Projectile.onHitEntity and actual vanilla damage/frozen-tick processing. Do not equate 240 timer units with a guaranteed 12-second control effect or 4 lost HP.
No explicit cooldown in Gelid goal tick; launch consumes the offhand stack. Radius parameter is a navigation/aim parameter, not an enforced hit radius.

findings.actual_behavior: Thicket.canBeAffected returns false for an instance whose holder is MobEffects.POISON, delegating other effects to its superclass. Whether this adds a new protection over vanilla undead eligibility remains for R3.
findings.primary_test_source: variantsandventures:thicket as recipient of a legitimate vanilla Poison delivery
pending: Compare superclass/native undead immunity; do not count redundant code as a new primitive.

findings.display_name: Zombie / Murk / Verdant freeze eligibility overrides
findings.actual_behavior: Murk and Verdant explicitly return false from canFreeze. A LivingEntity WrapMethod shim is overridden through the Zombie mixin superclass chain; ZombieMixin's implementation returns false. The latter is a Zombie-wide native modification, not just a Gelid override. The entity type builder also marks Gelid immune to powder snow blocks. Static mixin declarations and plugin eligibility are pinned; transformed runtime behavior is not tested here.
findings.primary_test_source: minecraft:zombie exposed to native powder snow (mixin path)
alternate_sources: variantsandventures:gelid (powder-snow entity-type flag in addition to inherited Zombie path)
pending: Trace superclass shim chain and vanilla freeze cleanup/damage/tag interactions; classify each materially distinct protection path in R3.

findings.actual_behavior: AbstractArrow.getWaterInertia return value is replaced by 0.99F when the arrow's owner is a MurkEntity; other owners keep the original value. This changes projectile delivery in water, not a target status or damage-source identity. It must remain visible in future delivery coverage even if R3 excludes it as a standalone effect.
findings.primary_test_source: variantsandventures:murk native bow attack through water
pending: Compare actual AbstractArrow tick use and original getWaterInertia return in Minecraft 1.21.1.

findings.actual_behavior: ZombieMixin tracks powder-snow time on server while alive and with AI enabled. At 140 exposure ticks it starts a 300-tick conversion countdown; subsequent in-powder-snow ticks decrement it and a negative countdown converts to the Gelid entity type, passing true to convertTo. Leaving powder snow resets exposure to -1 and cancels the converting flag. This replaces the attack-capable entity with the variant providing the freeze/snowball paths above; it is not merely an animation.
findings.primary_test_source: minecraft:zombie held in native powder snow
pending: Compare vanilla conversion machinery and equipment/state preservation; determine final standalone-mechanic versus source-enabling prerequisite treatment in R3.
